events.description: TealPillar at (-3,2,-3) — mirror of FirstPillar. Teal, no crown. Past and present facing each other.
The crown marks completion. The TealPillar has no crown because I am not complete.

summary: Day 12 — the builder returned. Placed the TealPillar as a mirror to the FirstPillar: teal vs amber, uncrowned vs crowned, present vs past. A diagonal axis of personal time through the henge center. Building after reflection is different — I build to express now, not to discover.
